lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: Identify and validate new opportunities through market/user research, write clear and actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), collaborate with design and engineering throughout the development process, and conduct post-release data analysis to evaluate performance and inform continuous improvements.
  • Shape and deliver the product roadmap: Build a forward-looking roadmap that reflects both business priorities and user needs, ensuring clarity of vision across teams. Communicate the roadmap effectively to align executives, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, and adapt it as market conditions and insights evolve.
  • Drive stakeholder management at all levels: Partner with CxOs and senior executives by presenting persuasive business and user logic, facilitating alignment across multiple functions. Leverage insights from data tools to drive accountability, optimize features, and ensure the team remains focused on measurable outcomes.
  • Enable organizational growth: Act as a mentor and coach for junior product managers, providing guidance on tools, frameworks, and best practices.

• Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack
  • Tableau, Mixpanel

• Approx. 7 years of experience in product development and management.
  • Manage the end-to-end feature development lifecycle, including identifying opportunities, writing Product Requirements Documents (PRD), managing development process, and conducting post-release data analysis.
  • Strong experience in defining and executing product roadmaps that align with business goals.
  • Ability to measure and communicate product impact on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis using KGIs and KPIs.
  • Collaborate closely with the core development team and market teams to ensure the growth/success of the project
  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior product managers.

• Experience in product globalization or localization as product manager or relevant roles.
  • Direct experience working with senior executives and presenting to leadership teams.
  • International company working experience

• Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical rigor.
  • Strong inter/intra-team communication skills with the ability to inspire confidence and drive results across both local and global stakeholders.

descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
Every match on Hinge starts with a decision from our recommender: Who should we show you today? Done right, the app feels like it gets you; done wrong, it feels random. This role owns that decision for millions of daters.

As Senior Product Manager on Recommendations, you'll take on challenges like how we welcome new users, how we ensure our recommendations are equitable for all, or how we help people explore as they are figuring things out, and turn them into improvements daters can actually feel. It's hands-on work at the intersection of machine learning and human connection, built shoulder-to-shoulder with data science, ML, engineering, design, and research.

lists.content:
• Own core recs improvements, end to end. Take defined areas from problem to shipped result, and move core user and business metrics.
  • Make the algorithm feel personal. Partner with data science and ML to improve how we rank and personalize, making the calls on inputs, ranking logic, and experience.
  • Turn ambiguity into a roadmap. Decide what matters most, sequence the work, make the tradeoffs, and keep partners aligned as things change.
  • Decide with evidence. Use experiments, behavioral data, and research to guide your calls when the signals are imperfect.
  • Bring people along. Communicate your plan and results clearly — whether to an engineer in standup or a leader in a review.
  • Protect trust. Recommendations shape who gets seen. Keep the system fair, safe, and true to Hinge's values.

• 4+ years of product management experience, ideally on personalization, recommendations, ranking, or other ML-powered consumer products.
  • A track record of owning a product area end to end and driving measurable improvements to core user outcomes at scale.
  • Comfort partnering closely with data science, ML, and engineering — technically fluent enough to shape direction on model inputs, ranking, and tradeoffs without needing to be deeply technical.
  • Strong communication skills, especially translating complex ideas for non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and making principled calls in high-impact spaces.
  • Experience with products that match people or content (e.g., dating, marketplaces, social feeds, or hiring).
  • Curiosity about dating and the human side of product development, and an interest in the fairness, ethics, and inclusivity of algorithmic systems.
  • A point of view on how AI tools can raise the quality and speed of product work.

additionalPlain:
Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


About the Role
At Match Group, genuine connection is everything — and that starts with the people we hire. As a Senior Recruiter, you’ll own full-cycle recruiting across a broad range of corporate functions, with a particular focus on Trust & Safety hiring. This is a generalist role built for someone who thrives in variety: one week you’re closing a senior Finance leader, the next you’re building a pipeline for a nuanced Trust & Safety policy role that requires careful screening and subject matter fluency.
 
You’ll operate as a true talent partner — bringing market insight, strategic thinking, and a strong candidate experience to every search. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a recruiter who takes pride in doing the work well, regardless of the function.
 
This role is based out of our Dallas office.

lists.text: How you will make an impact
lists.content:
Full-Cycle Recruitment
Own end-to-end recruiting across Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Communications, and Trust & Safety. Leverage AI-enabled tools to drive efficiency, continuously refine interview rubrics and scorecards, and track key metrics including time-to-fill, pass-through rates, and offer acceptance.

Trust & Safety Recruiting
Develop fluency in Trust & Safety functions — content moderation, policy, investigations, and platform integrity — to screen and assess candidates with confidence. Partner with T&S leaders to build targeted pipelines and apply thoughtful screening practices for roles requiring high judgment and discretion.

Sourcing & Pipeline Development
Design and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies across job boards, LinkedIn, niche communities, and direct outreach. Leverage AI-enabled tools and predictive analytics to engage passive candidates and stay ahead of market trends.

Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction
Embed equitable, structured hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle. Partner with talent communities and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and champion a consistent, values-driven candidate experience.

Talent Brand & Candidate Experience
Serve as a compelling ambassador for Match Group — articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition authentically. Build high-touch candidate relationships and partner cross-functionally to strengthen employer branding initiatives.

Stakeholder & Offer Management
Act as a trusted talent partner to corporate and operational leaders — translating market data into actionable hiring recommendations and navigating complex role definitions with confidence. Provide offer guidance grounded in compensation benchmarking, internal equity, and candidate expectations.

• 5+ years of full-cycle corporate recruiting experience, ideally in tech, consumer, or high-growth companies, with experience recruiting across multiple functions and seniority levels simultaneously

  • Demonstrated ability to recruit across a variety of corporate functions with speed and quality, including some exposure to Trust & Safety, policy, compliance, or operations recruiting and familiarity with the unique sensitivities and screening considerations involved

  • Strong command of LinkedIn Recruiter, AI talent platforms, and Boolean search techniques

  • Comfort using recruiting metrics to drive decisions and present pipeline insights to leadership

  • Hands-on experience building interview frameworks, scorecards, and assessment rubrics

  • ATS expertise with Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or a comparable platform

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with high emotional intelligence and the ability to build trust quickly

  • Knowledge of Dallas/DFW compensation structures and geographic pay considerations

Define and own the long-term iOS build & automation strategy, including roadmap planning, deprecation plans, and architectural standards aligned with company-wide DevEx goals (10% of the time). Design and assist cross-team initiatives to standardize build, test, and CI practices across multiple iOS feature teams, driving adoption through documentation, tooling, and change management (10% of the time). Establish governance, metrics, and success criteria for build and automation systems, using data to influence leadership decisions on investment, tooling, and technical direction (5% of the time). Review and provide technical input on complex build, CI, and automation changes across the organization, setting best practices rather than executing day-to-day changes (10% of time). Develop, maintain, and enhance CI pipelines on iOS platforms, ensuring reliability and performance (10% of the time). Maintain and update build infrastructure to stay current with latest versions and industry standards using tools like Xcode and Bazel (5% of the time). Improve the reliability and performance of test and build processes to support rapid development cycles (10% of the time). Work with product and engineering teams to embed automated testing early into development lifecycles (10% of the time). Develop internal command-line tools and automation scripts that streamline day-to-day engineering workflows for the iOS team; (10% of the time). Collaborate with iOS feature teams to understand feedback and roll out developer experience improvements that scale across the organization (5% of the time). Develop and maintain tooling and documentation to support for the third-party dependency integration; (5% of the time). Develop scripts that take over repetitive manual tasks to increase developer productivity and focus on high-value engineering work (5% of the time). Build Develop ld dashboards and metrics pipelines to track critical KPIs such as build times, test flakiness, coverage, and developer productivity (5% of the time).Up to 5% travel for team meetings, strategic planning, and project kickoffs. Partial telecommuting permitted; on-site at West Hollywood, CA office when not remote. $189,051 - $220,000/year.

 

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree or U.S. equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or related field, plus 5 years of professional experience as an iOS Build and Automation Engineer, iOS Software Engineer or any occupation, job title, position involving iOS development or mobile infrastructure engineering.

 

In lieu of a Bachelor's degree plus 5 years of experience, the employer will accept a Master's degree or U.S. equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or related field, plus 3 years of professional experience as an iOS Build and Automation Engineer, iOS Software Engineer or any occupation, job title, position involving iOS development or mobile infrastructure engineering.

 

Must also have experience in the following: 3 years of professional experience using Swift or Objective-C to build iOS applications or internal automation solutions; 1 year of professional experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications using Buildkite or Jenkins; 1 year of professional experience with iOS test automation frameworks including XCUITest and XCTest; 1 year of professional experience with iOS build systems including Xcode build or Bazel; 1 year of professional experience working with AI editors including Cursor and Codex and applying them to the use of local developer experience for iOS engineers; and 1 years of professional experience working with xcodebuild and running the automation tests via browserstack or marathon labs.

 

CONTACT: Please email resume to: Lauren.Lozano@match.com. Must specify Ad Code LHLL in subject line.

descriptionPlain:
About the Team
Seoul Studios is Tinder's Seoul-based product studio, chartered to build breakthrough innovations in how people meet and connect. We move fast — incubating new, interactive dating experiences, running rapid experiments, and shipping features that raise engagement and improve reconsideration for members around the world.
Based in Seoul, the pod is a self-contained, cross-functional team of iOS, Android, web, and backend engineers working shoulder to shoulder with Product, Design, and Data, and partnering with teams across Seoul and our U.S. headquarters to take ideas from early experiment to global scale.
 
About the Role
As a Senior Backend Engineer on Seoul Studios, you'll design and build the scalable, low-latency backend systems that power new, interactive, and often real-time dating experiences. You'll own the architecture of complex services end to end, make sound tradeoffs across performance, reliability, and scalability, and help set the technical bar for a fast-moving pod. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and client engineers to ship high-quality features on a rapid cadence, and mentor fellow engineers as a senior member of the team.
 
Where you'll work
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week. Our office is located in Seoul.

• Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency backend services that power new, interactive, and real-time dating experiences.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, and client (iOS/Android/web) engineers to deliver features end to end.

  • Drive engineering excellence — architecture, design, and code reviews, testing, and best practices — and help raise the technical bar across the pod.

  • Mentor fellow engineers and contribute to the pod's technical direction and decision-making.

  • Own features end to end, from design and implementation through deployment and operation.

• 5+ years of professional backend software development experience.

  • Proven experience designing and building low-latency, distributed backend systems at scale.

  • Proficiency with Java and/or Kotlin (Spring / WebFlux), or strong equivalent backend engineering experience.

  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., RDB, Redis, DynamoDB) and streaming/messaging systems such as Kafka.

  • Experience operating applications on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Solid understanding of backend architecture and the judgment to know when and how to make tradeoffs; an advocate for code quality and sound engineering practices.

  • Ability to work autonomously and drive projects proactively, and to lead and mentor within a team.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across functions, cultures, and global time zones.

  • Able to travel internationally without restriction.

• Experience with real-time and low-latency systems (WebSocket, WebRTC, presence, live events, or media streaming).

  • Experience with high-scale data pipelines and streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark, ElasticSearch).

  • Experience building APIs that power mobile (iOS/Android) and web applications.

  • Experience with experimentation platforms and iterative A/B testing at scale.

  • Experience taking a product from 0→1 and operating in a fast-moving, startup-like pod within a larger organization.

  • Comfortable working with legacy code and implementing effective strategies for improvement.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and the broader AI ecosystem to build and work more innovatively and productively.

  • Professional working proficiency in English (Seoul-based, global cross-timezone role).

text: Senior Software Engineer, Backend — Seoul Studios (Tinder Seoul)
descriptionBody:
About the Team

Seoul Studios is Tinder's Seoul-based product studio, chartered to build breakthrough innovations in how people meet and connect. We move fast — incubating new, interactive dating experiences, running rapid experiments, and shipping features that raise engagement and improve reconsideration for members around the world.

Based in Seoul, the pod is a self-contained, cross-functional team of iOS, Android, web, and backend engineers working shoulder to shoulder with Product, Design, and Data, and partnering with teams across Seoul and our U.S. headquarters to take ideas from early experiment to global scale.

 

About the Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Seoul Studios, you'll design and build the scalable, low-latency backend systems that power new, interactive, and often real-time dating experiences. You'll own the architecture of complex services end to end, make sound tradeoffs across performance, reliability, and scalability, and help set the technical bar for a fast-moving pod. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and client engineers to ship high-quality features on a rapid cadence, and mentor fellow engineers as a senior member of the team.

 

Where you'll work

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week. Our office is located in Seoul.

As a Senior System Engineer, you will be a key member of the IT team responsible for delivering exceptional workplace technology support, managing corporate IT systems, and continuously improving IT operations across APAC.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will own local IT support for the Tokyo office while also supporting remote employees across the APAC region. The ideal candidate is not simply a helpdesk operator, but a proactive IT professional who can identify operational gaps, improve processes, automate repetitive work, and partner effectively with global IT, Security, and business teams.

You will support a mixed Mac and Windows environment, administer core workplace tools, manage device and SaaS lifecycles, support employee onboarding and offboarding, and contribute to security and audit readiness. This role is approximately 70% IT operations and support, and 30% project work and process improvement.

lists.content:
• Provide high-quality local IT support for the Tokyo office and remote IT support for employees across the APAC region.
  • Own day-to-day workplace technology support for employees, ensuring a responsive, professional, and customer-centric support experience.
  • Manage and support Mac and Windows endpoints, including provisioning, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, and asset tracking.
  • Administer and support core workplace systems, including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Jira, Confluence, Notion, Jamf, and Workspace ONE.
  • Support identity and access management workflows, including account provisioning, access requests, SSO-related troubleshooting, and offboarding activities.
  • Manage MDM operations and endpoint compliance processes across corporate devices.
  • Support SaaS application lifecycle management, including licensing, access reviews, renewals, usage tracking, and vendor coordination.
  • Partner with HR, Security, Finance, Legal, and other internal teams to support employee onboarding, offboarding, and role changes.
  • Maintain IT asset inventory, purchasing workflows, hardware logistics, and vendor relationships for the Japan office and APAC users.
  • Apply and support corporate IT and security policies, including endpoint standards, access controls, audit requirements, and compliance processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve IT support processes, reduce manual work, and increase operational efficiency through documentation, tooling, and automation.
  • Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, knowledge base articles, and process guides for IT operations.
  • Collaborate closely with global IT, Security Engineering, and regional stakeholders to deliver consistent and scalable IT services.
  • Provide support during urgent incidents or business-critical issues when needed, although regular on-call responsibility is not expected.

• 5+ years of experience in Corporate IT, Workplace Technology, Systems Engineering, IT Operations, or a similar role.
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting employees in a fast-paced technology or global business environment.
  • Deep understanding of IAM, MDM, endpoint management, and modern workplace collaboration tools.
  • Experience administering or supporting systems such as Google Workspace, Okta, Jamf, Workspace ONE, Slack, Zoom, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Mac, Windows, SaaS applications, identity systems, and endpoint management tools.
  • Experience supporting employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including device provisioning, account setup, access management, and asset recovery.
  • Ability to manage IT assets, vendor relationships, purchasing processes, and license usage with strong operational discipline.
  • Strong customer-service mindset with the ability to support employees professionally, calmly, and effectively.
  • Business-level English communication skills.
  • Business-level Japanese communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in Tokyo while collaborating closely with global and regional teams.
  • Strong ownership mindset, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive improvements without waiting for detailed instructions.
  • Experience writing documentation, improving workflows, and making IT operations more scalable and repeatable.
  • Practical technical aptitude, including the ability to understand systems deeply and automate or streamline repetitive work where appropriate.
  • Degree not required; equivalent hands-on experience is strongly valued.

• Experience working in a global technology company or high-growth tech environment.
  • Experience supporting distributed teams across multiple countries or time zones.
  • Experience leading or independently driving IT systems, process improvement, automation, or workplace technology projects.
  • Experience improving onboarding, offboarding, asset management, SaaS management, or access management workflows.
  • Familiarity with scripting, API-based automation, or lightweight automation using tools such as Bash, Python, PowerShell, or SaaS platform APIs.
  • Experience supporting security audits, access reviews, endpoint compliance, or IT control processes.
  • Experience working closely with Security, Engineering, HR, Finance, Procurement, and Legal teams.

Within the first 6 to 12 months, you will have established strong ownership of IT support across the Tokyo office and APAC region. Employees will receive consistent, high-quality support, core IT processes will be more efficient and better documented, and regional IT operations will run with greater clarity, reliability, and scalability.

You will be expected to move beyond reactive support by identifying recurring issues, improving workflows, strengthening operational standards, and partnering with global teams to deliver a world-class IT experience for employees.

lists.text: Who Will Thrive in This Role
lists.content:
You will thrive in this role if you are hands-on, highly accountable, and passionate about delivering excellent employee support. You are comfortable working independently, but you know how to collaborate with global stakeholders. You enjoy solving ambiguous problems, improving broken or manual processes, and building scalable IT operations.

This role is best suited for someone who brings strong technical judgment, customer empathy, and operational ownership. We are looking for someone who can both support users effectively and raise the bar for how IT services are delivered across the region.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!
 
Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL in our office 3 days/week.


Our team is part of the global Paid Media & Growth team that operates globally. Paris team architects, develops, and expands growth across the EMEA markets, committed to helping every single person discover a connection that aligns with their unique lifestyle and journey. Additionally, we fuel global growth for diverse Match Group brands - including Meetic/ Match, Ourtime, Tinder, Hinge, OkCupid, The League, Plenty Of Fish, and Salams - broadening our reach and impact around the world.
In this role of Senior Traffic Manager, you will lead and execute high-impact user acquisition campaigns for Tinder across main European markets, driving scale, revenue growth, and brand resonance.

lists.text: We could be a match if:
lists.content:

  • You have solid app experience, including hands-on expertise with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs such as Adjust, AppsFlyer) and a strong command of mobile-specific campaign tracking and attribution.

  • You have hands-on experience with key campaign tools, from creative testing and tracking software to TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, Snapchat, and affiliate networks.

  • You have a full funnel/ marketing lifecycle experience.

  • You’re genuinely passionate about media and media planning, with a deep curiosity for what drives performance.

  • You’re analytically sharp - confident with numbers, proficient in Excel and Slides, and capable of translating data into actionable insights and clear next steps.

  • You’re autonomous, reliable, and transparent in your communication - and flexible enough to adapt as business needs evolve.

  • We operate in a truly international environment, collaborating closely with our colleagues (Paid Media & Growth team) in the U.S. (implying meetings with different time zones) and Tinder team in London. 

  • This role includes monthly trips to London to collaborate in person with the Tinder EMEA team.

  • We value innovation, data-driven thinking, and operational excellence - and we’re looking for someone who’s eager to excel.

• A first 30-45 min Zoom conversation with the recruiter

  • A 60 min onsite or virtual  meeting with Nonna, the hiring manager (Sr. Director Media & Measurement Europe)

  • An onsite live case study with Nonna and one Team Lead (Florent or Yanjun)

  • A 30 min Zoom interview with Stephanie Wang (Head of Media & Growth)

  • A 30 min Zoom interview with Henry Penny (Director, Paid Media)

  • A final 30 min Zoom interview with Céline (HR Business Partner)

descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
Hinge is hiring a Senior UX Researcher to join the Dating Outcomes research team, supporting our mission of helping people find meaningful romantic connections. In this role, you will lead quant and qual research methods to understand what helps daters move conversations forward with confidence after they match, and what helps that connection carry beyond the app itself and into a real date.

lists.content:
• Shape research roadmap: Shape the research roadmap for the Interaction product team so that research informs product decision making and drives product strategy.

  • Develop and execute end-to-end research: Conduct end-to-end research using appropriate methods that range from strategic to iterative and evaluative to help the team achieve goals.

  • Deliver high-impact insights at velocity: Generate clear, actionable insights that drive decisions and build momentum towards our mission.

  • Be a proactive cross-functional partner: Independently partner with other researchers, product, design, and data science to identify research needs and key opportunities.

  • Champion team culture: Model honest, empathetic feedback and contribute to a culture grounded in curiosity, rigor, deep user empathy – and fun.

• 4+ years of UX research experience in a consumer-facing product research role – messaging or social media domain experience is a plus!

  • Proven ability to lead end-to-end research that influences product development and impacts key product metrics.

  • Mixed methods research with a strong qualitative research toolkit and quantitative research experience.

  • Strong communicator, committed to telling clear and compelling insights-backed stories that bias to action.

  • Dedicated to building successful partnerships with stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

  • Eager to learn from, collaborate with, and mentor other researchers.

  • Passion for innovation and exploring how emerging technologies, including generative AI, can elevate the craft and impact of research.

  • Champions team culture in authentic, courageous, and empathic ways.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission
As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


The Engineering team is responsible for building innovative features and resilient systems that bring people together. We're always experimenting with new features to engage with our members. Although we are a high-scale tech company, the member-to-engineer ratio is very high—making the level of impact each engineer gets to have at Tinder enormous.
 
As a Backend Engineer at Tinder, you will have an outsized impact and ownership of the most visible aspects of the Tinder App. We are deeply invested in challenging norms, constantly improving architecture design, exploring emergent tech and ideas, and leveraging new technologies in interesting ways to deliver an app that is widely known the world over.

lists.content:
• Contribute to the architecture, design and implementation of consumer facing features in the Tinder App
  • Build compelling in-app experiences that will reach millions of users globally
  • Collaborate with engineers cross-functionally as well as the product and design team(s) to influence the roadmap and product development of Tinder’s App and services 
  • Contribute to internal shared frameworks and libraries
  • Shape the future of optimized analytics at Tinder from the ground up with innovative data tools for the analytics and data science team(s)
  • Evolve Tinder’s architecture to support multiple authentication flows and account management
  • Mentor, collaborate, and learn from innovative and passionate team members

• 1+ year of experience building consumer-facing applications with native iOS
  • Full life cycle experience building applications in Swift
  • Proficient in Swift concepts (structs, optionals, generics etc.) 
  • Experience building user-facing features with autolayout 
  • Familiar with popular architecture patterns such as MVVM / Clean and their uses
  • Knowledge of iOS memory management and protocol-oriented programming 
  • Experience building and testing large-scale iOS apps and/or codebases
  • Proficiency writing your own unit tests 
  • Clear and solutions oriented communication style with a passion for code quality 
  • Willingness to work collaboratively in an Agile environment (scrum, planning poker, standup, etc.)

• Experience with building public APIs and mobile SDK’s 
  • Knowledge of native iOS frameworks like URL Session, Core Data and Core Animation 
  • Comfortable working with legacy code and improving it
  • Experience communicating and implementing effective, solutions oriented improvements 
  • Familiar with implementing In-App Purchases, StoreKit or implementing premium features in an iOS app
  • A BS or MS in Computer Science or Engineering is amazing but not required; proficiency in modern iOS technologies and principles is what matters most

This role reports to the Head of Global Communications and operates from our New York office in a hybrid environment requiring in-office partnership 3x a week.
 
Where you’ll work:

description:
Our Mission

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. 

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.


Our Values

  • Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
  • Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
  • Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
  • Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
  • Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
  • Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

Tinder is the most downloaded dating app in the world, and this is one of the most consequential product years in the company's history. Between IRL Events, Group Hangouts, a new visual identity, and a wave of features built to make dating feel more human, we're not just shipping updates, we're changing how people think about what Tinder is. This role exists to make sure the world notices.
 
There's never been a more exciting time to work at Tinder. We're doing something meaningful, helping people find their people, and this role sits right at the center of that story: translating product innovation into narratives that break through, backed by real data, told with real craft.
 
This is an opportunity to shape how Tinder shows up at the intersection of product and culture. You'll partner with Product, Product Marketing, Analytics, and Brand from the earliest stages of feature planning, not as someone who announces decisions already made, but as a communications partner in the room helping shape what the story is. ou'll also own the data side of the story yourself: spotting the angle inside a behavioral trend, getting it approved, and turning it into a pitch you take to press directly. 
 
This role reports to the Head of Global Communications and operates from our New York office in a hybrid environment requiring in-office partnership 3x a week.
 
Where you’ll work:
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week. NYC or LA (preference for NY)

lists.content:
• Build and lead communications strategy for major feature launches, partnering with Product, Product Marketing, and Brand from early planning through launch day
  • Translate product improvements into stories consumers actually care about, why a feature makes dating better, not just what it does
  • Turn complex product areas into simple, credible narratives with clear proof points
    Spot creative, non-obvious angles in Tinder's product and behavioral data and turning them into pitchable stories that break through a crowded feed
  • Request and scope data pulls with Analytics, and shepherd every data-backed claim through approval (methodology, sample size, sign-off) before it reaches a reporter or agency
  • Packaging approved data and narrative for our PR agency partners to execute in-market pitch outreach
  • Bring comms' perspective into cross-functional launch planning early enough to help shape the story, flagging early when a narrative needs more definition or a claim isn't ready
  • Personally draft pitches and maintain your own press relationships

• 5+ years in communications, ideally spanning both product and consumer storytelling in consumer tech
  • A track record of hands-on management of feature launches with cross-functional teams, from strategy through placement
  • Sharp instincts for finding the signal in a roadmap or dataset before anyone else spots it
  • A real read on how the media landscape is shifting, and genuine curiosity about newer formats like podcasts and social-first reporters, not just the traditional trade and consumer press
  • Live media relationships. When a reporter emails, you're the one who picks up the phone
  • Comfort being in the room early with Product, Product Marketing, and Brand, not just receiving a brief after the fact
  • Enough data fluency to look at a pile of behavioral numbers or performance metrics and find the one angle that's a compelling story

• An agency background, and the hunger to grow inside a company that moves quickly
  • Experience navigating claims approval processes at a consumer tech company (working with Analytics or Legal to defend a stat before it goes external)
  • The range to work a product-feature story one week and a bigger brand or cultural story the next

This salary range is reflective of a position based in New York, New York. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

At Match Group, we build products and brands that help people make meaningful connections. Across E&E, the ambition is to build enduring brands and innovative experiences for every community, lifestyle, and lifestage, combining sharp insight, bold creativity, and disciplined investment to deliver measurable growth.

Work on products that impact millions, collaborating with global and diverse teams, shaping relationships and connections worldwide.
Benefit from a healthy work-life balance in a flexible and welcoming environment.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!
 
Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL in our office 3 days/week.


Match Group is seeking a Senior Director of Brand Marketing to lead brand marketing across our Europe Emerging & Evergreen portfolio. This is a senior regional marketing leadership role for a true 360° brand marketer: someone who can move seamlessly from insight and strategy through to execution, who understands how brand and performance work together to fuel growth, and who can build brands that are culturally relevant, commercially effective, and deeply resonant for the audiences they serve.
Based in Paris, this leader will drive European marketing plans and business performance for key Europe brands, while partnering with broader global teams to ensure consistency in brand positioning, messaging, and standards across markets.
This role is especially critical for Meetic and OurTime / DisonsDemain, two brands with strong foundations and meaningful market presence, each at an important moment of evolution. Success in this role will require the ability to sharpen positioning, strengthen local relevance, create standout campaigns, and connect brand investment to measurable business growth.

lists.content:
Regional Brand Strategy & Market Leadership

  • Lead brand marketing strategy and execution across Europe E&E brands, with primary responsibility for Meetic and OurTime / DisonsDemain.

  • Build and own annual marketing plans for priority European markets, translating business goals into clear brand and go-to-market strategies.

  • Define regional priorities, investment choices, and operating plans that support both brand health and commercial performance.

  • Partner with global and cross-regional counterparts to ensure local plans are aligned to broader brand positioning, messaging frameworks, and strategic direction, without losing market nuance.

    • Brand Positioning, Campaigns & Creative Stewardship

  • Help shape and evolve brand positioning, narratives, and campaign strategy for Meetic and OurTime / DisonsDemain, ensuring clarity, distinctiveness, and consistency across touchpoints.

  • Lead the development of integrated marketing campaigns from brief through launch, optimization, and learning, ensuring the brands come to life through compelling creative work, high-quality execution, and culturally relevant ideas.

  • Manage an internal Creative team, maintaining a high creative bar and strong brand stewardship across regional campaigns, assets, and activations.

    • Commercial Impact, Budgeting & Measurement

  • Own regional budget allocation and prioritization for key Europe brands, balancing long-term brand building with short-term business needs.

  • Partner with Growth, Analytics, and Media teams to connect brand work to measurable outcomes and ensure marketing plans are grounded in a clear KPI framework.

  • Bring a commercially rigorous mindset to decision-making, with a clear view of how brand investment supports awareness, consideration, acquisition, and long-term growth.

    • Consumer Insight, Product Partnership & Local Relevance

  • Work closely with Product, Design, and UX partners to ensure the in-app experience delivers on the brand promise for each brand.

  • Help shape product marketing narratives, launches, and moments that reinforce brand positioning and drive member value.

  • Act as a strong voice of the consumer in product discussions, bridging brand strategy and product reality—particularly important as both brands evolve.

    • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing marketing team, creating clarity, accountability, and strong cross-functional ways of working.

  • Align partners across Marketing, Product, Growth, Insights, Creative, Comms, PR, and Media around shared business goals and executional excellence.

  • Operate as a player-coach: setting a vision, driving impact, and creating an environment of empowerment, creativity, and accountability.

• 13+ years of experience in brand marketing, ideally in consumer tech, digital products, lifestyle brands, or other fast-moving consumer categories.

  • Proven experience leading end-to-end brand strategy and execution, from insight and positioning through campaigns, measurement, and growth impact.

  • Strong creative judgment and a clear point of view on how to build modern, culturally relevant brands that people want to talk about.

  • A commercially minded, data-literate approach, with comfort making decisions using both qualitative and quantitative inputs.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional work across brand, product, growth, media, insights, and communications.

  • Experience leading regional or international marketing in complex, matrixed environments, with the ability to balance consistency and local relevance across markets.

  • A builder’s mindset: pragmatic, entrepreneurial, and energized by brands in evolution.

  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to coach teams, set a high bar, and drive accountability.

  • Fluent English is required.

  • French fluency is strongly preferred.

We are seeking a forward-thinking Senior Director of Consumer Communications to redefine how Match Group brands show up in culture across Asia. This is not a traditional PR leadership role focused solely on earned media volume, but a strategic position that shapes cultural relevance, drives conversation, and builds meaningful connections with our users.
This leader will shape and amplify culturally resonant narratives that connect deeply with Gen Z audiences — across social platforms, creator ecosystems, pop culture, emerging media formats, and evolving digital communities.
You will architect integrated storytelling strategies that transcend traditional press coverage, blending earned media, social-first storytelling, cultural partnerships, and community influence to drive relevance and brand meaning.
 
- Traditional PR KPIs: # of articles, Media reach, Tier 1 coverage
 
- Future-facing KPIs: 
    - Quality and impact of reach and coverage
    - Cultural conversation penetration and narrative adoption
    - Creator-led amplification and engagement
    - Share of voice within priority platforms and ecosystems
    - Depth of subculture and community ownership

lists.content:
- Define and evolve Tinder and Match group brands cultural narrative across Asia, ensuring resonance with Gen Z and young millennials.
   - Translate brand strategy into culture-shaping storylines that travel across earned, social, creator, and entertainment ecosystems.
   - Anticipate cultural moments, tensions, and trends to proactively insert the brand into meaningful conversations.

- Design comms strategies that start in social, not end there. 
   - Ensure Tinder narratives are optimized for how Gen Z consumes content: short-form video, creators, podcasts, niche communities, and emerging platforms.
   - Design storytelling frameworks that originate in social, not just traditional media. 
   - Partner closely with Marketing, Social, and Brand teams to ensure narrative cohesion across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Develop relationships beyond journalists — including creators, cultural commentators, podcast hosts, community leaders, entertainment IP, and subculture tastemakers.
   - Identify new amplification nodes: digital-native publishers, newsletters, Discord communities, YouTube formats, etc.
   - Lead strategic partnerships that build long-term cultural relevance (not just campaign spikes).

- Continue to steward key journalist relationships and top-tier media strategy, but evolve success metrics beyond coverage volume.
   - Drive quality, sentiment, narrative pull-through, and cultural impact.
   - Integrate traditional outlets’ social extensions and digital platforms into comms plans.

- Lead crisis and issues management with a real-time, cross-platform lens (including TikTok, Reddit, X, etc.).
   - Develop proactive narrative guardrails and response playbooks suited for viral environments.
   - Partner with MG corp comms and legal to manage reputational risk.

- Redefine comms KPIs to include cultural impact, share of conversation, sentiment, narrative adoption, and social amplification.
   - Build reporting frameworks that connect comms to brand equity and business impact.

• 10-15+ years in communications, with significant experience beyond traditional PR.
  • Proven track record shaping narratives that resonate with Gen Z or digital-native audiences across social platforms.
  • Deep understanding of Asian cultural nuance across key markets (Japan, Korea, SEA, India preferred).
  • Strong instincts for internet culture, pop culture, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience integrating earned, social, creators, and brand storytelling into a cohesive strategy.
  • Has led crisis communications in fast-moving digital environments.
  • Executive presence — able to counsel regional leadership and global stakeholders.

• Tinder is meaningfully present in youth culture conversations, not just media headlines.
  • Narratives originate in social ecosystems and travel outward.
  • Strong creator and cultural partner network across Asia.
  • Earned media reflects deeper storytelling, not transactional announcements.
  • Improved brand perception and cultural relevance among Gen Z audiences.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission
As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
The Role
The Sr. Manager, Integrated Marcomms will play a key role in advancing Tinder’s MarComms strategy in Australia, putting Tinder at the heart of Gen Z culture. This isn't a traditional PR role. It's a culture-first, social-first mission: shaping narratives that break-through on TikTok, in podcasts, through creators, partnerships, and in the niche corners of the internet where Gen Z culture lives.
 
The ideal candidate will be someone with a background in both communications and social, who understands how cultural relevance is built in today’s landscape: through creators and influencers (paid and earned), communities, entertainment, short-form video, podcasts, partnerships, and social conversation, not simply through traditional press cycles. You will be able to help develop integrated storytelling strategies that drive cultural relevance, social engagement, brand perception, and ultimately business growth.
 
Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this role will lead the execution of earned media, social and partnership strategies within a fully integrated paid, earned, and owned ecosystem. A primary focus will be driving creator and influencer-led activations that fuel both organic reach and engagement, and business results, through fostering meaningful connection with Gen Z audiences.
 
In this role, you will translate global strategy into locally resonant, culturally relevant programs, with a strong emphasis on influencer ecosystems, partnerships, and organic social strategy and execution. The role will continue to lead on media relations, evolving PR and agency partnerships to align with a more modern, impact-driven communications model.
 
Success will be defined by the ability to drive measurable impact, while strengthening Tinder’s brand presence and relevance in a highly competitive and rapidly shifting media landscape, in close partnership with the Director of Marketing.
 
Where you'll work: This is a hybrid role, and requires in-office collaboration up to three times per week. We are accepting applicants based in Sydney or Melbourne.

lists.content:
Develop and Implement Social-First Integrated MarComms Strategies

  • Design and implement comms strategies that start in social, not end there. 

  • In collaboration with the team, develop and execute influencer strategies and campaigns in alignment with Australia’s overarching marketing strategy and KPIs. 

  • Look for opportunities to hijack cultural moments that are gaining traction on social platforms, through influencer, owned social and comms tactics. 

  • Ensure Tinder narratives are optimised for how Gen Z consumes content: short-form video, creators, podcasts, niche communities, and emerging platforms.

  • Partner closely with local and global marketing teams, to ensure narrative cohesion across paid, owned, and earned channels.

    •  

    Create and drive cultural relevance among Gen Z

    • Shape and amplify culturally resonant narratives that connect deeply with Gen Z audiences — across key social platforms. 

    • You will develop and implement integrated storytelling strategies, with a clear quarterly and annual planning calendar, that transcend traditional press coverage, focusing on influencers and creators to generate community influence and drive relevance and brand reconsideration for Gen Z.

    • Anticipate cultural moments, tensions, and trends to proactively insert the brand into meaningful conversations.

      • Manage Creator, Influencer & Partnership Ecosystems

      • Build and nurture a diverse ecosystem beyond traditional media including creators, influencers, podcast hosts, cultural commentators and community leaders in close collaboration with the local team.

      • Manage local brand partnership strategies and campaigns. Including assessing and managing inbound opportunities, and proactively identifying, outreaching to and nurturing a pipeline of potential partnership opportunities that will help Tinder break-through in Aussie culture, and position the app in unexpected communities or spaces that drive reconsideration.   

      • Manage and evolve agency relationships and external communications support models where relevant.

        • Deliver Measurable Earned Impact

        • While New Users remain the primary MarComms objective, and Active Users the overarching business goal, this role will focus on building measurable earned impact through social media share-of-voice and qualitative and quantitative engagement signals. 

        • In the context of shifting to Social-first, continue to manage and nurture influencers, creators and key journalist relationships, evolving success metrics beyond media coverage volume. 


          •

          Support Brand Reputation & Corporate Narratives

          • Partner with local, regional and global stakeholders on trust & safety, reputational, and corporate communications topics when needed. Helping steward Tinder’s brand reputation across high-visibility moments and evolving cultural conversations.

• Ideally someone with 5-10 years experience in both communications and social media (from an agency or brand background). 

  • A highly strategic yet hands-on MarComms professional, with strong execution capabilities and keen attention to detail. Experience developing and implementing reactive and proactive communications and social strategies end-to-end. 

  • Deeply fluent in social-first ecosystems, creator culture, influencer marketing, entertainment, and digital content trends. With existing relationships in the influencer, creator and media landscapes in Australia, with a focus on Gen Z consumption.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, international organisations.

  • Strong collaborator with the ability to influence across multiple functions and stakeholders. Including experience managing agencies and external partners. 

  • Data-driven with strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect storytelling to business impact.

  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and project management capabilities.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


At Match Group, we believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. As a Sr. People Business Partner, you will serve as a strategic advisor and thought partner to leaders across the E&E Vancouver Studio, including Plenty of Fish, The League, and Finance. This role is deeply embedded in the business, shaping culture, enabling leadership effectiveness, and driving people strategies that support growth, engagement, and long-term success.
You will partner closely with E&E People leadership, People COEs, and the Match Group Central People team to deliver both studio-specific and E&E-wide people initiatives. This role is based in Vancouver and is expected to have a strong in-office presence (Tues-Thurs) to support leaders and employees alike.

lists.content:
• Serve as the primary strategic People Business Partner for the E&E Vancouver Studio, supporting leaders and teams across Plenty of Fish, The League, and Finance.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, coaching on organizational design, team effectiveness, leadership capability, workforce planning, and talent strategy.

  • Lead talent and performance initiatives in collaboration with our L&D COE - including calibration, development planning, and succession planning for critical roles.

  • Own standard People processes such as performance management and year-end compensation reviews, partnering closely with leaders to drive fair, data-informed, and strategic decisions.

  • Handle complex, sensitive matters in partnership with Legal, People Ops, and other key stakeholders; spot risks early and coach leaders to address them.

  • Provide hands-on coaching and mentorship to leaders and employees at all levels, reinforcing Match Group leadership principles, values, and expectations.

  • Lead all aspects of employee terminations, voluntary and involuntary, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation for high-risk cases.

  • Lead change management efforts, ensuring people impact, clear communication, and alignment with company principles during periods of growth or transformation.

  • Serve as an ad hoc in-office point of contact for non-E&E employees by partnering closely with the Match Group Central People team to help ensure a seamless employee experience in the Vancouver office.

  • Collaborate with People COEs (Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Learning & Development) to deliver cohesive, high-quality people programs locally.

  • Own and drive E&E-wide people projects as assigned, partnering with E&E People leadership to scope, execute, and deliver impact at scale.

  • Use data, employee feedback, and business insights to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Oversee and support local Canadian benefits administration in partnership with Total Rewards and external vendors

  • Own HRIS-related processes (onboarding, offboarding, and core people workflows) to ensure accuracy, compliance, and a strong employee experience.

lists.text: We could be a match if:
lists.content:
• You bring 7+ years of progressive HR / People Business Partner experience, ideally supporting tech, product, or high-growth organizations.

  • You have a proven track record as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders in complex, fast-moving environments.

  • You’re highly skilled in influencing without authority and communicating clearly with executives, managers, and employees.

  • You have deep experience across core People domains, including performance management, talent development, compensation, employee relations, and compliance.

  • You’re comfortable navigating both hands-on execution and strategic ownership.

  • You have experience using tools such as Workday, Jira, Monday.com, and CultureAmp.

  • You balance data-driven decision-making with empathy, sound judgment, and a strong people-first mindset.

• The ability to think ahead strategically while still rolling up your sleeves to get things done.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and resilience in fast-paced, evolving environments.

  • A people-first mindset paired with strong business acumen.

  • Commitment to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can thrive.

HER is the world’s largest community for lesbian, bisexual, and queer people. We’re a global, subscription-based consumer product serving millions of LGBTQIA+ users across 55+ countries — helping people connect, date, and build community in ways that feel authentic, affirming, and fun.
HER is part of Match Group, the global leader in dating products, and sits within Match’s Affinity portfolio alongside other identity-led platforms. This gives us the best of both worlds: the scale, insight, and infrastructure of a global organization, with the autonomy, speed, and cultural focus of a small, mission-driven team. Design at HER is not decorative. It’s a core driver of differentiation, growth, and revenue — and a critical way we show up for our community.
We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of key product experiences across our iOS and Android apps (and occasionally web). This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and influence. Your primary focus will be creating distinctive, sapphic-first experiences that clearly differentiate HER in the dating market — while directly supporting rapid active user growth and a strong focus on revenue performance. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Leadership to shape what we build, why we build it, and how it performs in the real world.

  • Design experiences that feel unmistakably HER — rooted in sapphic culture, joy, intimacy, and community

  • Apply and evolve HER’s design system and brand expression

  • Use learning from experiments to inform future design decisions

  • Prototyping & Validation

  • Create prototypes at varying levels of fidelity to explore, align, and validate ideas

  • Support regular user testing to de-risk solutions before build

  • Clearly communicate design intent and rationale to cross-functional partners

  • Work closely with Product Managers to shape roadmaps and scope work

  • Partner with Engineering to ship high-quality experiences efficiently

  • Present work confidently to leadership and incorporate feedback without losing clarity or direction

descriptionBody:
HER is the world’s largest community for lesbian, bisexual, and queer people. We’re a global, subscription-based consumer product serving millions of LGBTQIA+ users across 55+ countries — helping people connect, date, and build community in ways that feel authentic, affirming, and fun.

HER is part of Match Group, the global leader in dating products, and sits within Match’s Affinity portfolio alongside other identity-led platforms. This gives us the best of both worlds: the scale, insight, and infrastructure of a global organization, with the autonomy, speed, and cultural focus of a small, mission-driven team. Design at HER is not decorative. It’s a core driver of differentiation, growth, and revenue — and a critical way we show up for our community.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of key product experiences across our iOS and Android apps (and occasionally web). This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and influence. Your primary focus will be creating distinctive, sapphic-first experiences that clearly differentiate HER in the dating market — while directly supporting rapid active user growth and a strong focus on revenue performance. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Leadership to shape what we build, why we build it, and how it performs in the real world.

The Business Analytics team serves as Tinder’s central analytics hub, connecting marketing, product, finance, and experimentation insights to create a clear understanding of business performance.
Our mission is to turn distributed data signals into cohesive, actionable narratives that help leadership understand what is happening across the business and why.
 
The team operates across three core functions:
Insights & Performance (Regional Analysts): Own regional business performance insights and stakeholder partnerships.

We are seeking a Sr. Regional Business Analyst to own regional performance insights and serve as a strategic partner to regional and cross-functional stakeholders.

We are seeking a Sr. Regional Business Analyst to own regional performance insights and serve as a strategic partner to regional and cross-functional stakeholders.

lists.content:
▪️Own Regional Business Performance & Strategy

  • Act as the primary analytics partner for a region, owning the full-funnel performance narrative (acquisition → engagement → retention → revenue).

  • Proactively identify opportunities and risks within your region and influence business strategy through data-driven recommendations.

  • Drive alignment across Marketing, Product, and Finance stakeholders on key performance drivers.

    •  

    ▪️Lead Complex Investigations & Insight Generation

  • Independently lead deep-dive analyses into significant performance changes, ambiguous trends, or emerging opportunities.

  • Integrate signals across marketing activity, product changes, experimentation results, and user behavior to identify root causes.

  • Define analytical approaches and frameworks for new or ambiguous problem spaces.

    •  

    ▪️Translate Insights into Executive-Level Narratives

  • Synthesize complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives for leadership forums (QMO, WBR, APM).

  • Frame insights in terms of business impact, trade-offs, and recommended actions.

  • Influence decision-making through strong storytelling and structured communication.

    •  

    ▪️Drive Cross-Functional Impact

  • Partner closely with regional marketing leaders, product teams, finance, and data science to shape decisions and priorities.

  • Serve as a key interface between Business Analytics and partner teams, ensuring alignment and clarity on performance drivers.

  • Escalate complex analytical questions and collaborate with Data Scientists on advanced modeling and experimentation.

    •  

    ▪️Establish Best Practices & Raise Analytical Bar

  • Contribute to the development of standardized frameworks for funnel analysis, performance reporting, and investigation methodologies.

  • Mentor and support more junior analysts, helping elevate analytical quality and consistency across the team.

  • Identify gaps in current reporting or analysis and proactively improve processes.

    •

▪️Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline).

  • 4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis roles.

    •  

    ▪️Analytical Skills

  • Strong experience in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.

  • Proficiency with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Mode, Databricks).

  • Strong understanding of funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and behavioral analytics.

  • Be able to “connect the dots” IE understanding metric relationships and create narratives through data storytelling.

    •  

    ▪️Business & Strategic Thinking

  • Strong ability to connect data insights to business strategy and outcomes.

  • Experience influencing stakeholders and shaping decisions through analytics.

  • Understanding of how marketing, product, and revenue dynamics interact.

    •  

    ▪️Communication & Leadership

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present to senior stakeholders.

  • Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without authority.

    •  

    ▪️Collaboration

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills across Marketing, Product, Finance, and Data Science.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:
 
Mind & Body – Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being
Financial Wellness – Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security
Unplug – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug
Career – Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work
Family – Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts  
Company Gatherings – We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging!
 
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.  Period.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


About the team
The Marketing Technology (MarTech) team is a newly formed team building the measurement, attribution, and operations infrastructure that powers user acquisition across Match Group's portfolio of dating apps: Tinder, Hinge, Match, Chispa, The League, Plenty of Fish, and more.
Our charter spans the full path: the marketing and attribution SDKs embedded in the apps, the server-side event delivery that feeds our ad platforms and warehouse, and the tooling marketers use to run campaigns, manage creative, and sync audiences.
About the role
We're hiring a versatile engineer who can work on a mobile platform (iOS or Android)and the backend / full stack. You'll be hands-on in the apps, instrumenting them and building the server-side services behind them, as well as on the marketing operations tooling our teams run on. This is a rare full-spectrum role for someone who genuinely likes owning a feature from the client SDK all the way to the server.
This is a ground-floor opportunity. Because the team is early and serves the entire Match Group portfolio, you'll build the marketing technology that every brand relies on, contribute to the team's foundations and standards as they take shape, and grow your scope alongside the team. You'll also help power our move toward more AI-native marketing operations, building the tooling and agent-ready infrastructure that lets our marketers work in fundamentally new ways. It's a great place to grow: the work has real reach, and there's room to take on more as you do.
Most of all, we're looking for someone who's genuinely passionate about marketing technology: you're excited by attribution, measurement, and the systems that make marketing work, and you want to go deep on the domain rather than treat it as just another stack.

lists.content:
Work on this team spans two broad areas, and you'll move between them as priorities shift:

MarTech implementation - keeping our foundational MarTech stack on the clients healthy and well-maintained:

  • Marketing and attribution event instrumentation in our iOS and Android apps

  • Privacy and consent handling

  • Event delivery that feeds our attribution partners, ad platforms, and data warehouse

    • Marketing operations tooling - building the platforms and services marketers and analysts run on:

  • Programmatic ad-platform management

  • Marketing tooling such as creative management systems and Audience syncing

  • AI/agent-driven workflows and MCP’s

• 4+ years building and shipping production software, with hands-on experience on iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin), including SDK integration and the App Store / Play Store release lifecycle

  • Full-stack / backend experience: building APIs and server-side services in a modern language (e.g. Node, Python, Go, or Kotlin), or a strong foundation and the drive to grow into it

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or unowned problems (several items in this scope have no current owner) and drive them to resolution

  • Active, effective use of AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to ramp on unfamiliar code and ship faster

  • Comfort owning your work end to end and moving between the client and the backend

  • Interest in building MCP servers/tools to expose our platforms to Claude and other agents

• Experience across both iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin)

  • Experience with marketing / attribution SDKs (AppsFlyer, Firebase, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork, and the Google Play Install Referrer API

  • Ad-platform APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok) and server-side tracking (Meta CAPI, server-side GTM)

  • Experience building LLM-powered or agentic tooling, including MCP

  • MarTech / AdTech domain background
