lists.content:
Brand-Specific Learning & Leadership Development 

  • Lead the learning and development strategy for E&E and Match Group Central, identifying priority skills and building targeted solutions that support growth across functions.

  • Partner with People Business Partners and leaders across functions and teams to co-create learning programs tailored to the brand’s needs.

  • Design and deliver leadership development programs for people leaders

  • Facilitate team effectiveness sessions (e.g., DiSC, design thinking) and leadership offsites that strengthen team dynamics and trust.

  • Create scalable, self-serve learning toolkits that meet teams where they are - fast, flexible, and tied to business goals.

  • Partner with People Business Partners and leaders to identify capability gaps and develop solutions to address them.

    • Career Growth & Talent Development

  • Revamp and evolve E&E and Match Group Central’s internal career pathways and job ladders, ensuring alignment with organizational structure, role expectations, and growth opportunities.

  • Partner with HRBPs and leaders to embed career frameworks into development conversations and talent reviews.

  • Provide manager training that increases transparency into career progression, pay practices, and market benchmarks.

    • Values & Culture Building

  • Embed E&E and Match Group Central’s values into talent programs, onboarding, leadership development, and recognition efforts.

  • Partner ERG leaders to build inclusive experiences that reflect the team’s diverse community.

  • Support cultural rituals like Monthly/Quarterly Huddles and offsites that foster connection, belonging, and shared purpose.

  • Lead engagement survey action planning efforts in partnership with E&E and Match Group Central leadership and Match Group resources.

    • Enterprise & Brand Collaboration

  • Localize and deliver Match Group corporate talent programs (e.g., mid-level manager development, succession planning, mentorship) to meet the needs of E&E and Match Group Central’s culture and org structure.

  • Identify E&E and Match Group Central-developed programs (e.g., onboarding, manager training) with the potential to scale across Match Group brands and facilitate knowledge sharing.

  • Apply change management best practices to drive adoption of new talent programs across global and cross-functional teams.

    • Organizational Development & Measurement

  • Partner with People leaders to design and facilitate team development sessions and leadership offsites.

  • Use feedback from engagement surveys, talent reviews, and pulse data to evolve programs and measure effectiveness.

  • Track and report on program impact, using data to inform decisions and shape future strategy.

• 8+ years of experience in Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or Talent Management.

  • Strong track record of building and facilitating talent programs that engage people leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience working across corporate and brand or business unit structures.

  • Ability to localize enterprise talent initiatives to fit the needs of a distinct brand culture and org model.

  • Familiarity with performance management cycles and engagement survey design or follow-through.

  • Cultural fluency and the ability to translate values into actionable programs.

  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • A builder’s mindset — comfortable iterating in ambiguity and scaling what works.

• Experience in tech or high-growth environments.

  • Familiarity with systems like Workday, Litmos or similar HRIS/LMS platforms. 

  • Certification in leadership or team development tools (e.g., DiSC, Enneagram).

  • Proficiency with authoring tools like Articulate or similar for digital learning content creation.

lists.content:
Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for engineering, data science, product roles — from intake through offer close, using AI-enabled workflows to drive efficiency at every stage.

  • Continuously refine interview rubrics, technical assessments, and scorecards to reduce time-to-hire and improve offer conversion. 

  • Track and present metrics including time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer acceptance, and hiring manager NPS.

    •  
    Sourcing and Pipeline Development

  • Design and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies using job boards, LinkedIn, niche communities, industry events, university partnerships, and direct outreach to build and maintain a healthy pipeline at every stage.

  • Leverage AI-enabled recruiting tools and predictive analytics to identify and engage passive candidates.

  • Partner with engineering managers to translate technical requirements into creative search strategies, staying ahead of market trends in software engineering, ML, and mobile development.

    •  
    Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction

  • Embed inclusive hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle, ensuring interview processes, candidate evaluations, and hiring decisions are structured, equitable, and focused on identifying the strongest talent.

  • Partner with talent communities, professional organizations, and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and strengthen pipeline diversity.

  • Champion a thoughtful and consistent candidate experience that reflects Hinge's values and employer brand.

    •  

    Talent Brand & Candidate Experience

  • Act as an ambassador for Hinge, articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition in a compelling and authentic way.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen employer branding initiatives and attract exceptional talent.

  • Build meaningful relationships with candidates, creating a high-touch experience that fosters engagement throughout the hiring process.

    •  

    Stakeholder and Offer Management

  • Act as a trusted talent partner to engineering and product leaders — translating market data into actionable hiring recommendations, facilitating calibration, and navigating complex technical role definitions with confidence. 

  • Provide offer guidance grounded in compensation benchmarking, internal equity, and candidate expectations. 

  • Maintain clear, timely communication with all stakeholders — candidates, HRBPs, operations team partners, and business leaders — conducting regular feedback sessions with hiring managers to continuously raise the quality of the recruitment partnership.

    •

• 5+ years full-cycle technical recruiting, ideally in tech or mobile-first companies

  • Ability to read engineering JDs, understand tech stacks, and have credible conversations with technical hiring managers

  • Strong command of LinkedIn Recruiter, AI talent platforms, and Boolean search techniques

  • Comfort using recruiting metrics to drive decisions and present pipeline insights to engineering leadership

  • Hands-on experience building technical interview frameworks, scorecards, and assessment rubrics

  • ATS expertise: Hands-on experience with Greenhouse, Lever, or Workday, or comparable ATS platforms.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, comfortable advising senior leaders and navigating ambiguity.

  • High emotional intelligence with the ability to build trust quickly with candidates and business partners.

    •  
    Preferred

  • Knowledge of New York compensation structures and geographic pay considerations.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission
As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


The Role:
At Tinder we're investing in a new way for our users to spark something new with someone new: IRL events. Events break the dating app paradigm of swipe, match, chat– introducing discovery anchored to real-world experiences, surfacing the coolest events and places in every city with the ability to connect with who’s in the room before, during, and after. 
As Senior TPM, you will own the cross-functional operating model for this fast-paced team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, BD, Partnerships, Event Ops, and Marketing leadership to bring clarity to ambiguity, structure to rapidly evolving plans and priorities, and deliver incredible user experiences at global scale. 
Where You'll Work:
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA.

descriptionBody:
The Role:

At Tinder we're investing in a new way for our users to spark something new with someone new: IRL events. Events break the dating app paradigm of swipe, match, chat– introducing discovery anchored to real-world experiences, surfacing the coolest events and places in every city with the ability to connect with who’s in the room before, during, and after. 

As Senior TPM, you will own the cross-functional operating model for this fast-paced team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, BD, Partnerships, Event Ops, and Marketing leadership to bring clarity to ambiguity, structure to rapidly evolving plans and priorities, and deliver incredible user experiences at global scale. 

Where You'll Work:

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA.

The Role:
At Tinder, Trust & Safety is foundational to what we do. As a Senior TPM, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and Analytics, as well as cross-functional stakeholders from Ops, Policy, and Legal to build and scale the infrastructure that keeps Tinder a safe place to spark something new with someone new, protecting our members from bad actors, harassment, and fraud.
We are looking for a candidate who can synthesize fragmented threads and tasks, organize unstructured, ad-hoc work, and respond to rapidly changing priorities. The ideal candidate will evaluate what’s working well from an execution standpoint and build on it, closing operational gaps and removing friction, while keeping all plates effortlessly spinning in the air.
Where You'll Work:
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA, though we also have offices in San Francisco and Palo Alto.

lists.content:
• Support end-to-end delivery for critical initiatives across safety product development, account integrity and identity, anti-abuse detection and mitigation, and moderation operations.
  • Own operational structure and hygiene by establishing consistent standards for tracking product roadmap initiatives, investigation findings, mitigation tasks, and infrastructure adjustments.
  • Partner with analysts, PMs, and engineers to coordinate the end-to-end lifecycle of abuse investigations—from initial detection through investigation, mitigation, and follow-ups—maintaining organizational visibility into progress and status.
  • Identify and coordinate inter-team dependencies while driving launch readiness and rollouts. You will own strategic alignment with key team members, including creating plans, managing risks, and refining communication models to ensure successful delivery.
  • Build and implement frameworks that drive operational excellence, systematically closing gaps and strengthening operational rhythms through subtle, high-impact refinements that don’t disrupt the team’s high-velocity culture.

• 6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, preferably within Trust & Safety, Integrity, or Security domains.
  • Hands-on experience with high-scale backend systems, distributed architectures, and managing complex technical dependencies.
  • Proven ability to seamlessly integrate into existing team workflows, building trust through collaboration.
  • Demonstrated success in cultivating strong cross-functional relationships and influencing outcomes in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, driven by thoughtfulness, an entrepreneurial mindset, and persistent execution.
  • Expert-level proficiency in managing cross-functional projects using tools like Jira.
  • The ability to synthesize complex technical risks and architecture decisions into actionable insights for less-technical stakeholders.
  • Deep experience creating delivery plans (including identifying trade-offs and managing risks), dependency maps, and release plans.
  • Expertise in agile methodologies and a deep understanding of software development best practices.

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Deep understanding of safety reporting, messaging, and account verification workflows in a mobile-first environment.
  • Familiarity with maintaining SLAs for mission-critical safety services.
  • Understanding of system design and the ability to meaningfully contribute to technical discussions.
  • Deep understanding of collaboration management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Google Suite, and Figma.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools (e.g., specialized LLMs) to automate routine program management tasks, improve documentation quality, and accelerate cross-functional communication.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


Match Group New York is seeking a highly organized and proactive Sr. Workplace Experience and Events Coordinator to lead the end-to-end planning, logistics, and execution of in-office events and experiences across the NYC campus. Named as one of the Top 100 Places to Work for three consecutive years, Match Group is a great place to build friendships, grow your career, and collaborate with top talent.
 
This is a full-time, in-office role, and candidates should expect to work onsite five days per week.

lists.content:
• Support New York employee experience perks and programs, including workplace events, wellness offerings, and brand-led events

  • Provide support for team onsite meetings, including coordination, scheduling, set up, and maintaining communications

  • Responsible for event ticketing system, providing support to different teams' happy hours, onsites, All Hands, and employee resource group-led events

  • Responsible for contractual onsite agreements between event-related vendors and Match Group (working alongside Legal partners)

  • Draft, update, and coordinate office announcements and communications, including digital communal boards

  • Provide on-site support running the day-to-day operation of our NYC campus, focused on providing best-in-class support for our employees

  • Collaborate with fellow members of the PREWF-IT (Protect, Real Estate, Workplace, Facilities, IT Infrastructure) team, aligning on workplace initiatives and processes

  • Support communications around employee experience and amenities initiatives

  • Partner with various vendors (events, snacks, catering, janitorial) to support in-person workplace services

  • Build relationships with Workplace business partners (EAs and team leaders, Legal, HR, IT, Finance, DEI), and external vendor services

  • Verify final invoice pricing and process payments promptly

  • Assist as needed with space planning tasks such as: New Hire desk set up, and onboarding and offboarding coordination

lists.text: We may be a Match if:
lists.content:
• You have 3+ years in professional/corporate event planning, with a proven track record of managing large-scale or complex programs

  • You have supported new hire and early belonging activities/programs 

  • You have exceptional organizational ability, effective problem-solving skills, and have experienced high-paced environments

  • You have a customer-focused attitude - ensuring consistently high quality resolutions

  • You have strong project and time management skills - managing multiple work streams and projects

  • You can adapt to changing priorities and are comfortable dealing with highly confidential information

  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to manage and draft office communications

  • You have financial and budget experience, including sourcing/procuring goods or services and following procurement best practices

  • You have strong relationship management skills and the ability to effectively interact with a diverse set of stakeholders

lists.text: How you will make an impact
lists.content:
Talent Strategy & Executive Partnership
 Partner with senior DEPA leaders to develop proactive hiring strategies aligned with long-term workforce plans. Translate market intelligence and hiring data into actionable recommendations, anticipate talent needs before they emerge, and challenge assumptions with data-backed perspectives.

Recruiting Excellence & Process Leadership
Lead end-to-end hiring for critical DEPA roles while continuously improving interview frameworks, assessment methodologies, and hiring processes. Drive calibration, elevate hiring rigor through structured interviewing, and leverage AI-enabled tools and analytics to improve efficiency and decision-making.

Market Intelligence & Talent Mapping
Maintain deep expertise across technical talent markets — tracking competitive landscapes, compensation trends, and emerging skill sets. Conduct talent mapping, execute sophisticated multi-channel sourcing strategies, and regularly brief leaders on market conditions to inform workforce planning.

Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction
Embed equitable, structured hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle. Partner with talent communities and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and champion a consistent, values-driven candidate experience.

Talent Brand & Candidate Experience
Serve as a compelling ambassador for Match Group — articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition authentically. Build high-touch candidate relationships and partner cross-functionally to strengthen employer branding initiatives.

Offer Strategy & Stakeholder Management
Guide leaders through complex hiring decisions balancing candidate experience, market realities, and internal equity. Develop competitive offer strategies and build strong partnerships across TA, People, Compensation, and business leadership to drive alignment and achieve hiring goals.

• 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting DEPA organizations in high-growth environments, ideally within consumer technology, marketplace, or mobile-first companies

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders through data, market expertise, and strategic consultation, including experience shaping hiring strategy across multiple technical functions and seniority levels

  • Strong sourcing, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement capabilities

  • Expertise in structured interviewing, assessment design, and process optimization

  • Experience leveraging recruiting analytics to drive continuous improvement

  • Strong business acumen and stakeholder management skills

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Trust & Safety professional to ensure alignment with global regulatory frameworks and contribute to our Safety by Design initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of product, policy, and compliance—partnering across engineering, legal, and operations to translate regulatory obligations into thoughtful, user-centered safety product requirements.
You’ll need to be able to communicate effectively with engineers and data scientists. You’ll help teams understand regulatory requirements, evaluate the effectiveness of solutions, and advocate for features that advance user safety without compromising product usability. You should be energized by tough product trade-offs, grounded in the realities of enforcement at scale, and thoughtful about how to design for safety in a proportionate way, user-respecting, and aligned with regulatory requirements.

lists.content:
• Work closely alongside our Legal team to translate safety regulations and codes of practice into actionable product requirements and design principles.

  • Act as a thought partner to product and engineering teams, especially on detection tooling, user-facing safety flows, and effectiveness measurement.

  • Evaluate safety system performance and make recommendations grounded in technical understanding (e.g., detection thresholds, false positives).

  • Write high-quality internal documentation, compliance narratives, and external-facing disclosures.

  • Serve as a cross-functional facilitator among product, legal, enforcement ops, data science, and more to align on safety system design and obligations.

  • Monitor evolving regional safety regulations and assess their implications for products and policies.

  • Contribute to external regulator briefings and product walkthroughs as required

lists.text: We may be a Match if:
lists.content:
• 5+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, product policy, or regulatory compliance, ideally with product-facing exposure.

  • Deep understanding of online harm types and interventions, including detection tooling and safety UX design.

  • Strong technical fluency—you’re comfortable analyzing detection performance metrics and communicating with engineers and product managers.

  • Excellent writing and reasoning skills; you produce clear, structured thinking in docs, even on complex topics.

  • Product mindset—you approach regulatory compliance and policy goals as design problems to solve, not boxes to check.

  • Familiarity with major global safety regulations affecting Trust & Safety..

  • Bonus: experience engaging directly with regulators or contributing to external transparency reports.

About the team
The Marketing Technology (MarTech) team is a newly formed team building the measurement, attribution, and operations infrastructure that powers user acquisition across Match Group's portfolio of dating apps: Tinder, Hinge, Match, Chispa, The League, Plenty of Fish, and more.
Our charter spans the full path: the marketing and attribution SDKs embedded in the apps, the server-side event delivery that feeds our ad platforms and warehouse, and the tooling marketers use to run campaigns, manage creative, and sync audiences.
About the role
We're hiring a senior, versatile engineer who can work across both mobile platforms (iOS and Android)and the backend / full stack. You'll be hands-on in the apps, instrumenting them and building the server-side services behind them, as well as on the marketing operations tooling our teams run on. This is a rare full-spectrum role for someone who genuinely likes owning a feature from the client SDK all the way to the server.
This is a founding-engineer opportunity. Because the team is early and serves the entire Match Group portfolio, you'll set its technical direction and standards, make the early architecture decisions the rest of the team will build on, and help shape and grow the team as it scales. You'll also help power our move toward more AI-native marketing operations, building the tooling and agent-ready infrastructure that lets our marketers work in fundamentally new ways. As one of the senior technical voices on the team, the work you do here has outsized reach across every brand in the portfolio.
Most of all, we're looking for someone who's genuinely passionate about marketing technology: you're excited by attribution, measurement, and the systems that make marketing work, and you want to go deep on the domain rather than treat it as just another stack.

lists.content:

Owning the bigger picture

  • Building the technical roadmap for our central MarTech services

  • Defining the architecture other engineers build against

  • Setting the engineering standards for the team

  • Identify opportunities for new systems or capabilities within existing systems.

    • MarTech implementation - keeping our foundational MarTech stack on the clients healthy and well-maintained:

  • Marketing and attribution event instrumentation in our iOS and Android apps

  • Privacy and consent handling

  • Event delivery that feeds our attribution partners, ad platforms, and data warehouse

    • Marketing operations tooling - architecting the platforms and services marketers and analysts run on:

  • Programmatic ad-platform management

  • Marketing tooling such as creative management systems and audience syncing

  • AI/agent-driven workflows and MCP’s

• 6+ years building and shipping production software, with strong experience on iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin), including SDK integration and the App Store / Play Store release lifecycles

  • Solid full-stack / backend chops: building and operating APIs and server-side services in a modern language (e.g. Node, Python, Go, or Kotlin)

  • A track record of setting technical direction, making sound architecture decisions under ambiguity, and raising the bar for the engineers around you

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and working with a data warehouse

  • Comfort owning work end to end and moving freely between clients and the backend

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or unowned problems  and drive them to resolution

  • Ad-platform APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok) and server-side tracking (Meta CAPI, server-side GTM)

descriptionPlain:
About the Team
Seoul is one of Tinder's key global hubs — home to cross-functional product pods building for hundreds of millions of members across 160+ countries. Our Seoul-based teams span Product, Design, Engineering (iOS, Android, web, and backend), and Data, working side by side to move fast: incubating new ideas, running rapid experiments, and shipping features that scale from a single market to Tinder's global business.

We partner closely with teams across the region and our U.S. headquarters, taking what works locally — new experiences, growth strategies, product bets — and turning it into playbooks and products that shape how Tinder shows up for members everywhere.


Our Mission
Launched in 2012, Tinder revolutionized how people meet and has become one of the world’s most popular apps for meeting new people. With tens of millions of users globally, Tinder continues to shape culture, spark conversations, and redefine how a new generation connects.

At Tinder, we believe meaningful connections start with authenticity, curiosity, and self-expression. We’re looking for a highly driven and culturally fluent Marketing Manager to help grow and evolve Tinder’s brand presence in Korea.
 
The Role
We are looking for a strategic, creative, and culturally plugged-in Marketing Manager to manage Tinder’s marketing initiatives in Korea.

This role will drive locally relevant brand and growth marketing strategies across campaigns, social, influencers, partnerships, CRM, product marketing, and consumer engagement initiatives. The ideal candidate deeply understands Korean youth culture and digital behavior, while also being highly comfortable operating within a fast-moving global organization.

You should be someone who can execute hands-on, collaborate cross-functionally, and constantly identify new ways to make Tinder culturally relevant and commercially impactful in Korea.
You will work closely with local, regional, and global stakeholders across Marketing, Product Marketing, Social, CRM, Comms, Legal, Media, and Partnerships teams.

This will be a 2-year contractor role.

lists.content:
• Manage the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies and campaigns across paid, owned, earned, social, influencer, CRM, experiential, and digital channels
  • Drive culturally relevant and insight-led marketing initiatives that strengthen Tinder’s brand relevance, engagement, and growth in Korea
  • Partner closely with creative and media agencies, PR/Comms, CRM, Product Marketing, Legal and other relevant regional stakeholders to deliver impactful 360 campaigns from ideation through execution
  • Manage and work closely with digital media agencies to oversee media planning, budget allocation, channel strategy, campaign optimization, and performance reporting across digital platforms

  • Analyze campaign, audience, and business result data to drive optimization, improve ROI, and support data-informed decision making

  • Strong sense of judgment and attention to nuance
  • Proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented mindset
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership, adaptability, and problem-solving capabilities

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:
 
Mind & Body – Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being
Financial Wellness – Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security
Unplug – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug
Career – Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work
Family – Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts  
Company Gatherings – We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging!
 
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.  Period.

About the Role 
As the VP of Product for Trust & Safety at Match Group, you will bring portfolio-level product leadership to our safety efforts across Match Group. You will own the long-term Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap across our brands and the shared infrastructure supporting them — spanning the systems that detect harm, the tooling our moderation and care teams use, the capabilities that keep us compliant with a fast-moving global regulatory landscape, and the user-facing features that make safety something people can feel.
You will build and lead a central team of product managers, and set product direction that engineering and operations build against. You'll sit within Match Group's central Trust & Safety leadership team and operate across each of our brands — building a deep understanding of each brand’s unique needs and focus areas, and defining a strategy that promotes safe and respectful interactions across our portfolio. Our north-star, and yours, is ecosystem health: whether people are, and feel, safe across every brand we operate.

You will build and lead a central team of product managers, and set product direction that engineering and operations build against. You'll sit within Match Group's central Trust & Safety leadership team and operate across each of our brands — building a deep understanding of each brand’s unique needs and focus areas, and defining a strategy that promotes safe and respectful interactions across our portfolio. lists.content:
Portfolio Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and maintain the long-term T&S product strategy for Tinder and multiple other Match Group brands, as well as our portfolio-wide central safety infrastructure, in collaboration with brand teams and stakeholders.

  • Deploy user research and a strong focus on our customers to decide what gets built, in what order, and why — prioritizing across the portfolio to build scalable, reusable solutions.

  • Set a clear point of view on proactive and felt safety: intervening before harm occurs, and making protection legible to the people we serve.

  • Serve as an external representative of Match Group and our safety efforts, helping to translate the work we do into a clear and convincing public narrative.

    • People & Organizational Leadership

  • Build, grow, and lead a high-performing central team of product managers across core safety workstreams.

  • Lead through a matrix. You and your team will partner closely with — and often depend on — brand product, design, and engineering teams. Create the working agreements, clarity, and influence that make that model deliver.

  • Build a culture of high standards, end-to-end ownership, and candor.

    • Build-Once Economics & Shared Infrastructure

  • Make portfolio-level build-vs-buy and vendor decisions: where to invest once in shared infrastructure, and where brand-specific solutions are genuinely warranted.

  • Identify capabilities being solved repeatedly across brands and consolidate them into shared services every brand can adopt.

  • Concentrate investment behind the highest-leverage bets, and raise development velocity on what you choose to fund.

    • Responsible AI

  • Champion the thoughtful application of AI across the safety surface — machine learning, LLMs, and emerging tooling — to improve detection and moderation quality, reduce reviewer load, and lower user friction.

  • Drive a culture of AI-enabled development across functions, including building tools and systems yourself and empowering others in Trust & Safety to effectively deploy agentic coding tools and other emerging technologies to accelerate our work.

  • Help deliver on our commitment to AI-augmented moderation and care at scale, without growing cost linearly with volume.

  • Hold the line on the guardrails: accuracy, fairness, privacy, and explainability.

    • Regulatory & Safety by Design

  • Translate a fast-evolving global regulatory landscape — including the EU Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act (Ofcom), Australia's Online Safety Act (eSafety), and emerging age-assurance requirements — into concrete product strategy.

  • Build safety and compliance into products by design, and ensure obligations are met consistently across brands and jurisdictions rather than reinvented for each.

    • Cross-Functional & Cross-Brand Partnership

  • Operate at the executive level across Match Group and its brands, partnering with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Policy, Operations, and brand product leadership to align priorities and clear obstacles.

  • Surface and resolve the tradeoffs where brand-local incentives (registration, engagement, revenue) and portfolio integrity priorities diverge — and make those calls defensibly, weighing both.

• 10+ years of product management experience in consumer technology, with significant time in Trust & Safety, integrity, or a closely adjacent domain (marketplace, rideshare, gaming, social, fintech).

  • A proven track record of building, developing, and scaling high-performing product teams, with a clear point of view on talent, culture, and how people do their best work.

  • Demonstrated success leading horizontal, platform, or multi-brand product work — building capabilities that serve many teams, not a single product surface.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI and machine learning in a product context. You understand both the possibilities and the guardrails, and you know how to apply each responsibly.

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous, fast-moving problems — regulatory change, emerging abuse, shifting threat models — into clear product strategy with measurable user and business outcomes.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to lead through influence: aligning brand and central stakeholders, and delivering results without relying on direct authority over every team you depend on.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the composure to operate in high-urgency, ambiguous environments without sacrificing long-term quality or team health.

  • Deep user empathy and consumer-centric thinking. You believe safety is a felt experience, not only a backend one.

• Experience operating across a multi-brand portfolio, or integrating products following acquisition.

  • Familiarity with non-US safety regulations and cross-jurisdictional compliance.

  • Familiarity with T&S operations, case management, and moderation workflows, and a track record of translating policy into product.

  • Experience partnering with AI/ML teams on detection, classification, or generative-AI risk mitigation.

About the Role 

As the VP of Product for Trust & Safety at Match Group, you will bring portfolio-level product leadership to our safety efforts across Match Group. You will own the long-term Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap across our brands and the shared infrastructure supporting them — spanning the systems that detect harm, the tooling our moderation and care teams use, the capabilities that keep us compliant with a fast-moving global regulatory landscape, and the user-facing features that make safety something people can feel.

You will build and lead a central team of product managers, and set product direction that engineering and operations build against. You'll sit within Match Group's central Trust & Safety leadership team and operate across each of our brands — building a deep understanding of each brand’s unique needs and focus areas, and defining a strategy that promotes safe and respectful interactions across our portfolio. Our north-star, and yours, is ecosystem health: whether people are, and feel, safe across every brand we operate.
